title: Feed Him MEOW 5,000-Recipe Ingredient Catalog
source: Pass25 canonical ingredient catalog + Pass26 seafood alias reconciliation

difficultyPolicy.rule: Ingredient may appear as a recipe ingredient or Garden filler only when active recipe difficulty >= ingredient.minimumDifficulty.
difficultyPolicy.fishRule: All fish/seafood begin at Medium or above in Feed Him MEOW, even when a real-world preparation can be simple, because fish adds Pinball Fishing acquisition and raw-seafood handling to the game flow.
